entity_types.description: A company Traceview sells to - segmented by size tier and industry.
A category of usage an account can adopt - Data Warehousing, Storage, Data Sharing - not a fixed SKU, a workload to expand into.
The overlay team on an account - AE (owns the relationship), SE (runs technical validation), or CSM (owns post-sale consumption health).
A systems integrator, cloud marketplace, or ISV that can source or co-sell a deal.
A sales opportunity for one workload at one account, tracked through a technical-validation-heavy funnel - a transactional event with a lifecycle, not reference data.
The committed spend created when a deal closes won - an account draws down against this via consumption, it is not the deal itself.
Monthly credit burn per account per workload - the actual usage an account's capacity contract is measured against.
A logged interaction tied to a deal - discovery call, POC milestone, exec review, QBR, renewal call - an event, not reference data.
A logged marketing engagement with an account - webinar, summit, paid ad, partner co-sell.
